deviations.detail: The evaluation command also executed the unselected issuer-headroom policy. This was outside the frozen evaluation plan. It is retained and reported as an unplanned diagnostic, excluded from selection and improvement claims. Selection remained baseline; evaluation results were not used to retune it.
